title: Arm C remembers: earlier units' graded failures in a repo become records for later units
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/night/proof-path.md; grant memory proof-redesign-grant (2026-11-18).
Outcome: evals/replay runs units of one repo in commit-date order; a graded failure of an earlier unit proposes an evidence-gated record (S15 path) that arm C serves to later units of that repo; arms A and B never see it.
Files: evals/replay/arm-c.ts, evals/replay/run.ts, src/brain/
Proof: a replay test with two units of one repo shows the record from unit 1 served to unit 2 in arm C only; a pilot on the 20 non-frozen pilot units writes rows for A, B and C.
Operator 2026-11-19: S8 A/B/C is the priority after the host-capacity line and t-k7xx0kq. Raised to P0 as S8 critical path.
